title: Vividly Tender French Wensleydale Boeuf Bourguignon
description: A classic French dish with a twist, featuring tender beef and Wensleydale cheese in a rich, sour broth. This sugar-free-friendly recipe is perfect for a special occasion.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the beef short ribs with salt and pepper.
Heat a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat and sear the beef short ribs until browned on all sides.
Remove the browned beef from the pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onions, carrots, and celery to the pot and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the red wine, beef broth, tomato paste, thyme, and bay leaves to the pot and stir to combine.
Return the browned beef to the pot and bring the mixture to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 2 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Remove the pot from the oven and stir in the crumbly Wensleydale cheese.
Let the mixture cool slightly before serving.
